title: Gold swing

instrument.source: Twelve Data XAU/USD spot, checked on every download (symbol, quote currency, not a futures contract)

assumptions: Instrument: XAUUSD Spot · quote currency USD · price unit USD per troy ounce · market type Spot Gold · data source Twelve Data XAU/USD spot, checked on every download (symbol, USD, not a futures contract). Never COMEX futures (GC=F) and never MCX. Results saved before 18 Nov 2026 came from GC=F futures: they are archived as historical futures-based analysis and are not part of these statistics. Your broker's XAUUSD quote can differ by its spread. Times are shown in IST.

Gold swing = your swing playbook on gold: daily structure, 1H confirmation (rejection in the zone, close back over the 9 EMA on 1.5x volume), long AND short (shorts are found on the mirrored chart with the same rules), stop beyond the daily order block with a 0.25 ATR buffer, T1 1R half (no early breakeven), T2 2R a quarter with the stop to entry, T3 3R, closed after 28 days.

The weekly-trend (against the trade) and 2R-room hold-backs are applied. Costs: 0.35 dollars per ounce on a round trip (spread plus commission), taken off every trade in R. Overnight swap or financing on held positions is NOT modelled.
